exclusionInstruction: Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
generationPrompt: Landscape editorial social-card background. Left side stays clear and readable with matte warm off-white paper, no words or lettering. On the right is a dramatic charcoal frame with an original small still of a skater on a clay bank set inside it. Successive terracotta crop marks suggest the picture extending outward, with additional quiet landscape within the outer frame. Use a believable photographic still with tactile paper margins and no digital glow. Place visual weight on the right and preserve the center reading area. No copy, mark, logo or watermark. Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
